items.title: Strix now supports Vercel AI Gateway
items.summary: , the open-source AI penetration testing tool, can now run on any of the 400+ models on Vercel .StrixAI GatewayStrix can reach models from Anthropic, OpenAI, Kimi, GLM, Deepseek, and others through a single API with no markup, removing the need to sign up for multiple providers. Usage and cost are tracked across all models in AI Gateway. Strix selects the Gateway through , where the model is the standard AI Gateway  ID behind a  prefix:STRIX_LLM<provider>/<model>vercel_ai_gateway/See  to configure it and get started today.Strix's AI Gateway setup guideRead more
